from PIL import ImageEnhance, ImageFilter

# Function to enhance and OCR each image
def enhance_and_ocr(image_path):
    img = Image.open(image_path)
    # Convert to grayscale
    img = img.convert('L')
    # Enhance contrast
    enhancer = ImageEnhance.Contrast(img)
    img = enhancer.enhance(2.0)
    # Apply a slight sharpen filter
    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)
    # OCR
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
    return text

# Run enhancement and OCR on each image
enhanced_episode_texts = [enhance_and_ocr(path) for path in image_paths]

# Combine and preview the result
enhanced_combined_text = "\n\n".join(enhanced_episode_texts)
enhanced_combined_text[:3000]  # Preview the first 3000 characters for inspection
